"SQUATS NEVER STOP"
Day: 10 Thursday 10-10-24

Warm Up: Practice Doing some
"Unbroken Sets" of back Squats. These
are done with absolutely no pauses
or breaks during the set. The reps
go down and up continuously until
the set is done.

1. BACK SQUAT "UNBROKEN"
6 sets of 6 reps @ 65%
6total sets. 36 total reps. 2min rest

2. BENCH PRESS "UNBROKEN"
5 sets of 8 reps @ 65%
2min rest

Cardio

skullcrushers x30 reps

"Day 10: Squats Never Stop"
Warm up: Practice doing some "Unbroken Sets" of back squats. These are done with absolutely no pauses or breaks during the set. The reps go down and up continuously until the set is done.
1. Back Squat "Unbroken" 6 sets of 6 reps @ 65%
rest 2:00
2. Bench Press "Unbroken" 5 sets of 8 reps @ 65%
rest 2:00
3. EZ Bar Skullcrushers 1 set of 30 reps
* Or BB, "Unbroken", Cardio
